units: percent for accuracy; millions for parameters; GFLOPs at 640 input
reporting_notes: Reported full-model AP50 entries reuse the main FPO-YOLO-s result (48.1265761807%, displayed as 48.1%).
Remaining control measurements retain their experiment records; SIoU remains 47.9%.
COCO size AP and Ultralytics AP are different calculations and are reported separately.
UAVDT values use the 24/6 sequence-level validation split, not the official test split.
Additional datasets are trained independently; evaluation does not measure zero-shot transfer.
complexity_scope: VisDrone2019 profiling records; class count and model fusion state affect parameter counts.
